issue.title: [iface_mode test case] iface mode test fails on Montara, Arista-7170-64C platforms

failure.body:
**Description**
iface_mode test case is working with interfaces visibility in Alias and Default mode.
The problem is, that test case expecting that Interface names in Alias and Default mode will be    different (as it is in  Mellanox-SN2700-D48C8/port_config.ini)
According to https://github.com/Azure/SONiC/wiki/Porting-Guide if Vendor did not specified Alias value,  **Alias port value will be equal to Default port value**.
Also if default port names will be part of alias port names test case will fail.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
Run iface_mode test on t1 topology:
ansible-playbook test_sonic.yml -i inventory --limit <testbed> -e testbed_name=<testbed> -e testbed_type=t1 -e testcase_name=iface_mode
**Describe the results you received:**
Test case failed

**Describe the results you expected:**
Test case passed

**Additional information you deem important:**

    **Output of `show version`:**
    SONiC Software Version: SONiC.HEAD.593-dirty-20200311.041812
    Distribution: Debian 9.12
    Kernel: 4.9.0-11-2-amd64
    Build commit: fc91f81d
    Build date: Wed Mar 11 <IPV6> UTC 2020
    Platform: x86_64-accton_wedge100bf_32x-r0
    HwSKU: montara
